summary.headline: Choose routes with an owner, a real decision and a test we can finish by June.
summary.text: Start with the five priority candidates below. They are research choices; institutional agreement has not been verified. Check who can approve each change and what the current rules already require. Coverage and approval fractions remain unknown. The tests and pass criteria are proposals, not results.

impact.label: Verified safeguard reach (not causal safety impact)
impact.description: Freeze eligible units and period. covered_i=1 only when duty is in force, evidence channel works and a usable remedy applies; weights are observed spending, value added, output or delivered compute, not strategic judgments. Report adopted-only coverage separately. Report baseline and intervention test-success rates and their potentially negative difference separately.
impact.limits: All route values currently unknown. Matched GVA supports economic activity coverage; GDP requires consistent tax allocation. National/world GDP is context only. Do not divide multi-year funding stocks or gross procurement by annual GDP and label it bounded coverage. Separate hardware strata, tokens, allocations, delivered hours and supply-chain stages; union overlapping final units and do not add serial-stage percentages. No coverage ratio establishes catastrophic-risk reduction.

feasibility.label: Documented exact-scope approval readiness (not delivery probability)
feasibility.formula: For a complete selected sufficient set of N required approval acts: documented fraction S/N; unknown-state evidence bounds [S/N, (S+U)/N]. Otherwise null.
feasibility.description: S is valid, evidenced approval of the exact instrument; U is genuinely unresolved status, excluding confirmed pending/opposed. Show deduplicated independent institutions, required signatures, internal/cross-owner handoffs, missing owners, AND/OR/threshold logic, reserved matters and critical blocker separately. A separate complete signatory-slot register permits signature completion. Legal voting weights only where instrument and electorate establish them.
feasibility.limits: Every current graph is incomplete: full agreement ratios and signature totals are null, not zero. Instrument counts are not individual signature counts. Lower-bound institutions are not total parties or probability. Generic leader support is context, not assent; unresolved is not opposed. A veto cannot be averaged away. Finite approval ratios are discrete observations on a 0–1 scale, not artificially smooth measurements. Critical-path dates require durations and resources, currently incomplete.

forecast.label: Probability of an operational safeguard by 21 June 2027
forecast.reason: No comparable-route outcome cohort or calibrated model was retrieved. Need prespecified reference class, failures/withdrawals/right-censoring, dependencies, held-out-time calibration and uncertainty. Readiness and leader support cannot substitute.

stages.label: Selected for further testing
stages.description: Analyst shortlist with falsifiable increment and real or conditional decision path; not institutional consent.

stages.label: Institutionally selected
stages.description: Authorised owner documents the choice of exact safeguard and scope; generic endorsement and event participation insufficient.

stages.label: Adopted
stages.description: Effective rule or executed instrument names obligor, scope and remedy.

stages.label: Implemented and observable
stages.description: Reconciled inventory, usable evidence pipeline and exercised escalation; draft or signature alone insufficient.

stages.label: Changed behaviour
stages.description: Prespecified comparison shows relevant changed release, reporting or containment, retaining failures, cost and migration. Simulation remains simulation.

stages.label: Causal safety effect
stages.description: Credible counterfactual identifies effect on a specified real safety endpoint with uncertainty; benchmark/drill success is not catastrophe reduction.
